material_definitions: The material is a lithium containing sulfide with the LGPS structure type, studied as a solid electrolyte for all-solid-state batteries.
Its structure consists of one-dimensional chains formed by LiS6 octahedra and (Ge0.5/P0.5)S4 tetrahedra, connected via common edges and corners with PS4 tetrahedra.
The value is cited to demonstrate an extremely high conductivity, almost equaling liquid electrolytes.
The solid solutions investigated in the present study are LGPS-related phases Li(10+\u03b4)M(1+\u03b4)P(2-\u03b4)S12 (M=Si, Sn), synthesized via a conventional solid-state reaction.
warnings: Value cited from an external source.
Temperature is inferred as Room Temperature (298 K).

material_definitions: The material Li10SnP2S12 is an LGPS-type solid solution formed by substituting Ge4+ with Sn4+.
The purpose of its investigation is related to finding alternatives to rare and expensive germanium.
This compound exhibits a lower conductivity compared to the parent Li10GeP2S12 phase.
The solid solutions investigated in the present study are LGPS-related phases Li(10+\u03b4)M(1+\u03b4)P(2-\u03b4)S12 (M=Si, Sn), synthesized via a conventional solid-state reaction.
warnings: Temperature is inferred as Room Temperature (298 K).

material_definitions: A previous material search on the pseudo binary Li4SiS4-Li3PS4 system indicated the existence of the lithium conducting phase, Li3.4Si0.4P0.6S4, which was regarded as a member of the thio-LISICON family.
The Li3.4Si0.4P0.6S4 phase is composed of a three-dimensional framework structure formed by isolated PS4 tetrahedral units, which is different from the LGPS-type structure.
warnings: Data cited from external reference (13).
Temperature inferred as 298 K (room temperature).

material_definitions: The solid electrolytes synthesized were LGPS-type phases defined by the general formula Li(4-k)M(1-k)PkS4 (M = Si, Ge, Sn).
Ionic conductivity was measured by the ac impedance method over the temperature range of 253 K to 373 K.
The Si system showed maximum conductivity at k=0.55 (Li3.45Si0.45P0.55S4) and the Sn system showed maximum conductivity at k=0.73 (Li3.27Sn0.27P0.73S4).
